title: Build a Blinking LED
subject: Circuits
description: Follow along and wire your first working circuit.

quiz.prompt: Why does an LED need a resistor in series with it?
choices: To limit the current so it doesn't burn out
quiz.explain: An LED will happily pull more current than it can survive. The resistor is what keeps it alive.

quiz.prompt: Which leg of an LED is the positive side?
quiz.explain: The long leg is the anode (positive). LEDs only conduct one way, so backwards means no light at all.
